name: 単語の説明を読み削除を取り消す
prompt: Edit image 1 only as a palette correction. Image 1 is the existing candidate; image 2 is the native Japanese geometry and copy authority. Preserve image 1's current canvas, all text and line breaks, typography, card and banner geometry, speaker button bounds, progress track and fill length, spacing, and every element position. Change only two color regions: recolor the speaker glyph (not its button surface or outline) to neutral slate #526173; recolor the existing 12% progress fill to the exact owner-approved green gradient, linear-gradient(135deg, #174C36 0%, #1F6444 58%, #2D8F5E 100%). Keep the progress track neutral gray. The gray speaker glyph is a supporting utility icon, and the short progress fill is the semantic progress marker. Keep the top deletion banner charcoal, its white text unchanged, card and page pure white, and all other text and colors unchanged. Preserve exact Japanese text and punctuation: 単語を削除しました; 元に戻す; ねこ; 名詞; ネコ科に属する、; 人と暮らす小さな動物。; 「灰色のねこと暮らしています。」; 12%の進み具合; 削除. Do not add, remove, move, resize, redraw, or restyle anything. No shadow, texture, tint, new UI, or typography changes.
reviewNotes: Opened the saved candidate and compared it with v002 and the native preview. The speaker glyph is now slate and the short progress fill visibly retains green; page/card surfaces stay white, the progress track stays neutral, and copy appears unchanged. The earlier v002 record already noted geometry and typography drift; this palette-only pass intentionally leaves that residual unchanged and does not claim exact native geometry. Raster gradient stop values, native editability, app implementation and owner approval remain unverified. Manifest only; no catalog or publication refresh. Pixel audit after registration found the short progress fill too close to flat and too bright relative to the specified first stop; keep this attempt pending correction.
